field_constraints.personal_info.date_of_birth: must be valid ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null
field_constraints.insurance_details.effective_date: must be valid ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null
field_constraints.insurance_details.termination_date: must be valid ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) or null
field_constraints.coverage_info.deductible: must be positive number or null
field_constraints.coverage_info.out_of_pocket_max: must be positive number or null
field_constraints.coverage_info.copay_visit: must be positive number or null
field_constraints.insurance_details.plan_type: must be one of: HMO, PPO, EPO, HDHP, POS or null

logical_rules: member_id must not be empty string
at least one of email or phone should be present
if plan_type is specified, it must be valid
effective_date should not be in the future
termination_date should be after effective_date if both present
